content.text:
The cell editor now opens on top of the cell you're editing, in both the team view and the project view.

**Cause:** The editor box is placed with `position: absolute` and measured from the top-left of the grid. But the grid container had no `position` set. So the box was placed from a container further up and to the left, which is why it showed up one row higher and to the left in both of your screenshots.

**Fix:** The grid's outer container in [excel_grid.jsx](components/alloq-commons/src/alloq_commons/components/excel_grid/excel_grid.jsx:636) now sets `position: relative`, so the editor is always placed from the grid itself. I put this in the shared component rather than in the planning page styles, so every grid that uses it gets the fix.

**Checked:** In your running app, with the grid scrolled down 200px, I double-clicked a cell. The editor's position and size matched the cell exactly. I closed it with Escape, so no data changed. I didn't add a test, because the existing JS tests only cover the grid logic, not the page layout.

I also added `.claude/launch.json` so the browser preview can attach to your dev server on port 8080.
